question: From which country's constitution has the Constitution of India borrowed the feature of Single Citizenship and Parliamentary system of Government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The UK**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Features borrowed from the United Kingdom

 
 
• **Parliamentary government**
 
• Rule of Law
 
• Legislative procedure
 
• **Single citizenship**
 
• Cabinet system
 
• Prerogative writs
 
• Parliamentary privileges 
 
• Bicameralism
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
 

 **Country**
 **Features Borrowed**
 
 

 Australia
 
 
 
• Concurrent list
 
• Freedom of trade
 
• Commerce, and intercourse
 
 
 
 

 Canada
 
 
 
• ​Federal System
 
• Residuary powers with the centre
 
• Advisory jurisdiction of the supreme court
 
 
 
 

 The US
 
 
 
• ​Fundamental Rights
 
• Judicial Review
 
• Independence of judiciary
 
• Written Constitution
 
• Supreme Court (Organisation, its power, removal of Supreme Court and High court judges)
 
• The preamble of the constitution
 
• Vice-President (Post, Functions)
